author: Mark Atwood
text: Edge-case review finding for your audit scope (spec/06-security.md:765, exposed by the 1k3i reconciliation of §8.5/§8.7): §8.11 route hash input is 'the 8-byte IID from the transit node's address', computed by root and egress from the Source-Route Header. Under upstream AddrForKey the routable /128 is bit-packed inverted key material and the SHA-512 IID is NOT recoverable from the address (the old IID==low-64-bits invariant is gone), so root and egress cannot compute matching route_hash values — tunnel authorization fails closed on every packet. Redefine the route-hash input in terms of SRH-visible bytes (e.g., the lower 8 bytes of each hop's 02xx address, or the full 16-byte addresses) when auditing §8.11.
